individual_dispositions.text: Consider a constructed greenhouse relay. Measurements of temperature enter a model; a forecast of afternoon heat leads a controller to open a vent; later measurements return. The achieved temperature is partly a consequence of acting on the prediction. Comparing it with the prediction must therefore retain the intervention. A forecast of excessive heat is not refuted merely because the action it prompted prevented that heat.
